QUOTE: "**Code axis:** clew cannot fix it from inside the session. Restart the MCP client so it loads current code, then run `index(action='refresh', force=True)`." and "**Data axis:** clew handles it automatically... `_refresh_stale`" and "An index stamped newer than the server can never be cleared by a rebuild"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists different remedies per axis (auto-refresh/rebuild for data, client restart for code) but never says that this difference is why a single flag would not have been enough.
